answer: The nebula holds work receipts rather than names, so the river of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
